title: /tpr Teleport Random Command
description: Teleport To Random People With A Single Command!
body:
Teleport To Random Players With a Custom command /tpr

Whats Built in?

- Anti Self Teleport

- Permissions
- teleport.use
- default: op

- Built In Cooldown Manager (30s) To Not Teleport To the same person over and over again

I Hope you like this plugin that i made!

Made by: Pingz0
